docs.title: Resilience
docs.heading_path: What is Amazon DynamoDB? > Resilience
docs.snippet: By default, DynamoDB automatically replicates your data across three Availability Zones to provide high durability and a 99.99% availability SLA. DynamoDB also provides additional capabilities to help you achieve your business continuity and disaster recovery objectives.

docs.title: DynamoDB pricing
docs.heading_path: What is Amazon DynamoDB? > DynamoDB pricing
docs.snippet: DynamoDB charges for reading, writing, and storing data in your tables, along with any optional features you choose to enable. DynamoDB has two capacity modes with their respective billing options for processing reads and writes on your tables: on-demand and provisioned.
